source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)

source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder; not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Thai written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. The English lines are the drafter's own.
source.licenseNote: Owned by the course authors; machine-drafted, not yet native-reviewed.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native Thai review (preferably a Chiang Mai speaker; the text is spoken-standard Central Thai). Speakers: sam=Sam (man; ผม … ครับ), mali=Mali (woman; ฉัน … ค่ะ / คะ), ton=Ton (man; ผม … ครับ). For the reviewer - polite particles by speaker (Sam and Ton ผม … ครับ; Mali ฉัน … ค่ะ, and คะ in questions); address by คุณ + name; "ได้ครับ" as the answer to "can you speak Thai?"; "มาจาก" for "come from"; "นิดหน่อย" for "a little".
